# Lemonless — for coding agents

Buy smart. Stay lemonless. Used-car Check + Find with a fixed JSON verdict.
TypeScript owns the numbers; settle credits only after success.

## Auth
- Create a key at /developers (signed-in browser).
- Send `Authorization: Bearer af_YOUR_KEY` on every REST and MCP call.
- Scopes: `read` | `check` | `find` (default: all three).
- Optional: `Idempotency-Key` on paid calls to retry without a second charge.

## Tools (MCP POST /api/mcp)
- `check_car` — VIN | listing URL | pasted text. Free monthly check or 1 credit after success. Scope: check.
- `find_cars` — natural-language request → `run_id`. Scope: find. Then `find_cars_status` / `find_cars_result`.
- `deal_radar` — free make/model scan. Scope: read.
- `full_report` — full VIN report, 1 credit. Scope: check.

## REST
- `POST /api/v1/check` — same as check_car
- `POST /api/v1/find` → 202 `{ run_id }` ; `GET /api/v1/find/{run_id}/status` ; `GET /api/v1/find/{run_id}`
- `GET /api/v1/receipts` and `GET /api/v1/receipts/{id}`
- `POST /api/v1/report` — full report (existing)

## Discovery
- /.well-known/agent.json
- /openapi.json
- /llms-full.txt
- /developers (curl + MCP config + OpenServ auth note)

## Errors
Every 4xx/5xx includes `error_code`, `message`, `credit_spent`, `retry_safe`, and `next_steps.request` (method/url/body).

## Costs
- No on-chain payment required. Site report credits + free monthly Check allotment only.
